name: IPECACUANHA
key_symptoms: Tongue usually clean. Mouth, moist; much saliva. Constant nausea and vomiting, with pale, twitching of face. Vomits food, bile, blood, mucus. Stomach feels relaxed, as if hanging down. Hiccough.
Bones of skull feel crushed or bruised. Pain extends to teeth and root of tongue.

Dyspnœa; constant constriction in chest. Asthma. Yearly attacks of difficult shortness of breathing. Continued sneezing; coryza; wheezing cough. Cough incessant and violent, with every breath. Chest seems full of phlegm, but does not yield to coughing. Bubbling rales. Suffocative cough; child becomes stiff, and blue in the face. Whooping-cough, with nosebleed, and from mouth. Bleeding from lungs, with nausea; feeling of constriction; rattling cough. Croup. Hæmoptysis from slightest exertion (Millef). Hoarseness, especially at end of a cold. Complete aphonia.
Body stretched stiff, followed by spasmodic jerking of arms towards each other.

mind_symptoms: Irritable; holds everything in contempt. Full of desires, for what they know not.

gi_symptoms: Tongue usually clean. Mouth, moist; much saliva. Constant nausea and vomiting, with pale, twitching of face. Vomits food, bile, blood, mucus. Stomach feels relaxed, as if hanging down. Hiccough.
urinary_symptoms: Uterine hæmorrhage, profuse, bright, gushing, with nausea. Vomiting during pregnancy. Pain from navel to uterus. Menses too early and too profuse.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Body stretched stiff, followed by spasmodic jerking of arms towards each other.
skin_symptoms: Pale, lax. Blue around eyes. Miliary rash.
sleep_symptoms: With eyes half open. Shocks in all limbs on going to sleep (Ign).
fever_symptoms: Intermittent fever, irregular cases, after Quinine. Slightest chill with much heat, nausea, vomiting, and dyspnœa. Relapses from improper diet.
